Elementary guruhlar, bugun oila mavzusi: my, their va 's.
5 ta savol, bittasi o'tgan darslardan. Avval o'zingiz o'ylab ko'ring, keyin izohini o'qing 😉

params.question: My father's sister is my ___.
params.explanation: Otaning yoki onaning opa-singlisi aunt (xola, amma). Uncle esa erkak qarindosh, cousin amakivachcha yoki xolavachcha.

params.question: Kamila and Sherzod have a new flat. ___ flat is near the park.
params.explanation: Kimningdir narsasi haqida gapirganda their (ularning) ishlatamiz. There joyni bildiradi, they're esa they are degani.

params.question: Our lesson starts at 9:45. That's quarter ___ ten.
params.explanation: 45 daqiqa o'tdi, 10 gacha 15 daqiqa qoldi. Shuning uchun quarter to ten deymiz. Quarter past ten esa 10:15 bo'ladi.

params.question: Choose the correct sentence.
options: The childrens' room is very big.
The childs' room is very big.
The children room's is very big.
The children's room is very big.
params.explanation: Children o'zi ko'plik, s bilan tugamaydi, shuning uchun unga 's qo'shamiz: children's. Childs degan so'z yo'q.

params.question:
Find the mistake:
"Is this Aziz bag? No, it's his brother's. His brother's name is Timur."
params.explanation: Ism bilan egalikni 's orqali ko'rsatamiz: Aziz's bag. "It's his brother's" esa to'g'ri, bag so'zi takrorlanmagan, xolos.
